rationale: The SDK enables BLK_INLINE_ENCRYPTION_FALLBACK and DM_DEFAULT_KEY; native LTS __submit_bio invokes crypto preparation while current->bio_list is active, so recursive encrypted submissions can hold the resources an allocation awaits. This avoids both recursive-submit deadlock and waiting on pages held by the current partial bio without importing the bulk-mempool refactor. Preserve early LTS alignment validation, on-stack requests, native completion/error behavior and dm-default-key skip-bit propagation.
